title: Wire the integration test principal for staging with staging-only trust
description:
Staging acceptance (conversation/bin/acceptance.ts --environment staging) fails with 403 on bearer exchange. Wire the integration test principal in the production AWS account with trust limited to staging only; production must never trust it.

Feature: Staging acceptance
  Scenario: Bearer exchange
    Given the staging integration principal exists
    When acceptance runs with --environment staging
    Then bearer exchange succeeds and acceptance passes
right_now_summary: The staging integration principal still needs staging-only trust wired in the production AWS account.
